trend_method.model: unweighted OLS linear probability model: endorsed ~ observation_date
trend_method.uncertainty: CR1 sandwich standard errors clustered by hashed respondent
trend_method.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg and Bonferroni adjustments across eligible signifiers

leader_sensitivity.selection: top 10 positive and top 10 negative unadjusted slopes
leader_sensitivity.model: unweighted OLS linear probability trend adjusted for linear age, missing age, demographics status, sex, ethnicity, student status, employment, weekday, and month of year
leader_sensitivity.uncertainty: CR1 sandwich standard errors clustered by hashed respondent

early_late_sensitivity.selection: top 10 positive and top 10 negative linear slopes
early_late_sensitivity.model: unweighted difference in endorsement prevalence after versus on/before the full observation window's calendar midpoint
early_late_sensitivity.uncertainty: CR1 sandwich standard errors clustered by hashed respondent

within_respondent_sensitivity.selection: top 10 positive and top 10 negative pooled slopes
within_respondent_sensitivity.model: unweighted pooled and respondent-fixed-effect linear probability trends on the same repeat-respondent observations
within_respondent_sensitivity.uncertainty: CR1 sandwich standard errors clustered by hashed respondent, counting absorbed respondent effects in residual degrees of freedom
